cards.name: Village
cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions.

cards.name: Smithy
cards.text: +3 Cards.

cards.name: Witch
cards.text: +2 Cards; each other player gains a Curse.

cards.name: Militia
cards.text: +2 Coins; each other player discards down to 3 cards.

cards.name: Moat
cards.text: +2 Cards; When another player plays an Attack card, you may reveal this from your hand. If you do, you are unaffected by that Attack.

cards.name: Gardens
cards.text: Worth 1 VP per 10 cards in your deck (rounded down).

cards.name: Cellar
cards.text: +1 Action; Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

cards.name: Festival
cards.text: +2 Actions; +1 Buy; +2 Coins.

cards.name: Laboratory
cards.text: +2 Cards; +1 Action.

cards.name: Library
cards.text: Draw until you have 7 cards in hand. You may set aside any Action cards revealed; discard them when you're done.

cards.name: Market
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; +1 Coin.

cards.name: Merchant
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; the first Silver you play this turn gives +1 Coin.

cards.name: Mine
cards.text: Trash a Treasure from your hand. Gain a Treasure costing up to $3 more than it, putting it into your hand.

cards.name: Moneylender
cards.text: +1 Action; you may trash a Copper from your hand for +3 Coins.

cards.name: Poacher
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Coin; discard a card per empty Supply pile.

cards.name: Remodel
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $2 more than the trashed card.

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Trash and/or discard any of them. Put the rest back on top in any order.

cards.name: Throne Room
cards.text: You may play an Action card from your hand twice.

cards.name: Vassal
cards.text: +1 Coin; reveal the top of your deck; if it's an Action, play it; otherwise discard it.

cards.name: Artisan
cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $5, putting it into your hand.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.text: Gain a Gold; each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, trashes a revealed Treasure other than Copper, and discards the rest.

cards.name: Bureaucrat
cards.text: Gain a Silver onto your deck; each other player reveals a Victory card from their hand and puts it onto their deck (or reveals a hand with no Victory cards).

cards.name: Chapel
cards.text: Trash up to 4 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Council Room
cards.text: +4 Cards; +1 Buy; each other player draws 1 card.

cards.name: Harbinger
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; look at the top card of your discard pile, you may put it on top of your deck.
